Weapons.Certainty.Likely: ≈ From its name and how the game uses it; not documented.

Weapons.About.DamageType: The kind of damage: AP (armor-piercing), HE, small arms, artillery... Each kind has its own levels and its own effect on each armor.
Weapons.About.Level: The damage's level within its kind. For AP kinds, a higher level beats thicker armor. Only the levels the kind has are taken.
Weapons.About.DamageRadius: Radius around the impact that also takes damage.
Weapons.About.SuppressionRadius: Radius around the impact that also takes suppression.
Weapons.About.SuppressesOnMiss: A near miss still suppresses the target.
Weapons.About.WeakerWithRange: Kinetic AP and AA guns only: the table that lowers their damage level with distance. None for missiles, HEAT and HE.
Weapons.About.Tandem: A tandem warhead, as the game gives the PzF 3, RPG-29, Vikhr and Ataka (17 weapons). Its effect in battle isn't documented.
Weapons.About.HarmlessToAllies: Doesn't damage your own units. On for 343 weapons, mostly guns, machine guns and rifles.
Weapons.About.FireChance: Chance, from 0 to 1, that a hit starts a fire (the weapon's Fire). Only weapons with a Fire have it: 0.05 to 1 in the game.
Weapons.About.Fire: The fire an incendiary weapon starts (FireDescriptor.ndf); none for others.
Weapons.About.Smoke: The smoke a smoke round makes (SmokeDescriptor.ndf); none for others.
Weapons.About.TopArmor: Always strikes the target's top armor. On for 41 weapons: bombs and cluster munitions.
Weapons.About.TopArmorOnHit: A hit strikes the top armor. On for artillery, mortars and bombs (282 weapons).
Weapons.About.ArmorFromImpact: The armor side hit is worked out from where the shot lands, not from where it was fired. On for artillery, mortars and bombs.
Weapons.About.IgnoresFlammability: On for 21 incendiary weapons. What it skips isn't known.
Weapons.About.Minimum: Shortest range against ground units: closer targets can't be fired at.
Weapons.About.Helicopters: Longest range against helicopters; 0 if it can't fire at them.
Weapons.About.Planes: Longest range against planes; 0 if it can't fire at them.
Weapons.About.Missiles: Longest range against incoming missiles. Only the two active protection systems have one.
Weapons.About.Stopped: Hit chance per shot when the firing unit is stopped, before range, suppression and other modifiers.
Weapons.About.Moving: Hit chance per shot when the firing unit moves.
Weapons.About.FallsWithDistance: Hit chance drops as the target gets farther, by the range table in HitRollConstants.ndf.
Weapons.About.Critical: Raises the chance that a hit causes a critical effect. 25 on most weapons, 0 on the others.
Weapons.About.DispersionFar: How far a miss lands from the target at maximum range.
Weapons.About.DispersionNear: How far a miss lands from the target at minimum range.
Weapons.About.SpreadAngle: Angle the shots spread over. 0 for guns; above 0 for missiles, bombs and flamethrowers.
Weapons.About.CorrectedSpread: Artillery only: spread multiplier once fire is corrected on a spot. 0.7 in the game, 0.25 for guided shells.
Weapons.About.SuccessiveHits: 1, 3 or 5 in the game. Likely caps the bonus for hitting the same target again; not confirmed.
Weapons.About.AccuracyBase: Always 0 in the game. Likely added to the hit chance in every case.
Weapons.About.AccuracyTargeted: Always 0 in the game. When it applies isn't known.
Weapons.About.Aiming: Seconds from seeing a target to the first shot.
Weapons.About.PerSalvo: Shots in one salvo, before reloading. Weapons sharing an ammo box must keep the same number.
Weapons.About.AtOnce: Shots fired at the same moment within a salvo.
Weapons.About.BetweenShots: Seconds between shots within a salvo. Unused when a salvo is one shot.
Weapons.About.Reload: Seconds between two salvos: the reload time.
Weapons.About.ReloadAtLeast: Shortest reload when it varies; -1 when it doesn't. Set on 46 aircraft rockets.
Weapons.About.ReloadAtMost: Longest reload when it varies; -1 when it doesn't.
Weapons.About.Supply: Supply used to refill one salvo.
Weapons.About.ShownPerSalvo: The ammunition count the game shows per salvo. Interface only: an AA gun firing 6 shots a salvo shows 48.
Weapons.About.EffectsBetween: Seconds between firing effects (flash, sound). Shorter than Between shots on fast-firing guns.
Weapons.About.FiresMoving: Can fire while the unit moves.
Weapons.About.MustDeploy: Must stop and deploy before firing, as howitzers do.
Weapons.About.FirePosition: Offers the Fire Position order: firing at a spot on the ground with no target.
Weapons.About.SalvosAtPosition: Salvos fired by one Fire Position order. Set exactly on the weapons that offer it.
Weapons.About.Indirect: Fires over obstacles, as artillery does; no for direct fire.
Weapons.About.Reflex: Off for artillery, mortars and bombs. Likely lets the unit fire at targets on its own; not confirmed.
Weapons.About.NoReflexOnPriority: On for guided missiles (187). Likely stops reflex fire while a priority target is set; not confirmed.
Weapons.About.OnePerDistrict: On for most direct-fire weapons (677). Likely hits only one unit in a town district; not confirmed.
Weapons.About.ProjectileKind: Shell, artillery shell, guided missile, bomb or grenade: how the projectile flies.
Weapons.About.Acceleration: Missiles only: how fast the missile reaches its speed.
Weapons.About.Arc: Indirect fire only: the angle the shell is fired at (15°, 35°, 45° or 58° in the game).
Weapons.About.Corrections: Missiles only: seconds between two corrections of the missile's course.
Weapons.About.FireAndForget: The firing unit is free once the missile is away. On for 57 missiles.
Weapons.About.Guidance: Radar or anti-radar homing (32 missiles); none for the others.
Weapons.About.Submunitions: Releases bomblets, as cluster bombs and shells do (38 weapons).
Weapons.About.Missile: The missile flown (MissileDescriptors.ndf); none for other weapons.
Weapons.About.ShotsInOrder: Off for guns, artillery and rockets (570). What it orders isn't known.
Weapons.About.AffectedByNumber: On for 252 weapons: machine guns, rifles and autocannons. Its effect isn't known.
Weapons.About.Noise: How much firing gives the unit away: a stealth penalty. 1 to 5 in the game.
Weapons.About.ShotsToNoise: Shots fired before Firing noise is at its full effect.
Weapons.About.Picture: The weapon's picture in the game's interface. The ✎ on the picture above, or a click on this value, picks another weapon's.
Weapons.About.Traits: The trait icons the game shows beside the weapon. Interface only. A click on the value ticks them in a list of the game's traits.
Weapons.About.ComparedWith: The group of weapons the game's min/max bars compare it with.
Weapons.About.ShowsDamage: The game shows the weapon's damage.
Weapons.About.ShowsSalvoAccuracy: The game shows the accuracy for the whole salvo.
Weapons.About.EffectSize: How large the firing and impact effects are: medium or ultra heavy.
Weapons.About.Cursor: The cursor shown when aiming the weapon.
